prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Name & Badge Redesign: Redesign the adoption certificate layout into a split view featuring a custom name input component and an official pet adoption badge.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Make It Official!", "body": "Give your new desktop companion a name and receive your official adoption badge.", "components": [{"type": "name_input", "text": "Pet Name", "style": "rounded"}, {"type": "badge", "label": "Certified Companion", "style": "playful"}]}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Pet Docking Tips Screen: Add a new screen 'new_pet_docking_guide' before home_intro to visually guide users on how to move, hide, and talk to their desktop pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_pet_docking_guide", "home_intro"], "home_intro": {"headline": "Your Companion is Ready!", "body": "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen."}}
2: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Adoption Selection: Reorder the sign-in step to occur after pet selection and certificate creation so users build an emotional bond before creating an account.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"], "sign_in": {"headline": "Save Your New Pet", "body": "Sign in now to save your custom pet progress and cloud sync settings."}}
3: [home, new_flow] Desktop Pet Rendering Waiting Stage: Transform the waiting screen into a dynamic stage layout complete with background progress indicators, tip carousels, and pet animations.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Bringing Your Pet to Life...", "body": "We are generating your desktop companion's animations.", "show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Tips while you wait", "style": "calm"}, {"type": "animation", "asset": "asset:pet_hatching", "style": "playful"}]}}
4: [choose_path, hint] Path Choice Desktop Pet Style Hint: Add clear microcopy hints to the path options detailing preset adoption versus photo-based custom pet creation.
   config: {"choose_path": {"hint": "Select Quick Preset for ready-made pets, or Custom Creator to generate from photos."}}
5: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Backup Sign-In Assurance Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to explicitly reassure users that sign-in protects against pet loss or reset.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Secure Your Companion & Cloud Save", "body": "Sign in to keep your pet saved across app restarts and prevent data loss."}}
6: [home, wait_info] Live Pet Generation Time Estimate Banner: Display explicit live time estimates and countdown status on the waiting screen while rendering pet assets.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Pet generation typically takes 1 to 3 minutes. Please stay on this screen."}}
7: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Ready Notification Opt-In: Add a desktop notification switch to alert users when pet asset generation finishes in the background.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "components": [{"type": "button", "label": "Notify Me When Ready", "action": "open_tip", "style": "rounded"}]}}
8: [adoption, layout] Two-Column Pick Friend Selection Layout: Change pick_friend screen layout to a two-column design with choice cards for faster side-by-side companion preview.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Choose Your Starting Companion", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "text": "Select Pet Species", "style": "playful", "action": "choose"}]}}
9: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Quick Controls Summary: Update the home intro text with quick desktop control instructions for summoning, moving, and hiding the pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Welcome Your Desktop Pet!", "body": "Tip: Right-click your pet anytime to access controls, switch modes, or hide companion to tray."}}

verdicts.reason: The redesigned certificate maintains its function of displaying the adoption with an official badge/stamp.
Adding a new onboarding guide screen before home_intro is allowed and preserves all required steps.
Reordering sign_in to occur after adoption is explicitly allowed under Rule 4 and retains all steps.
Redesigning the waiting screen into a dynamic stage layout preserves its job of showing the pet being made.
Adding descriptive microcopy to choose_path retains options for both adopting and making your own pet.
Updating sign-in copy to emphasize cloud save and data security stays within onboarding rules.
Displaying a time estimate for an actual asset generation wait is permitted under fair design rules.
Adding an optional ready notification toggle on the waiting screen is a valid onboarding enhancement.
Changing pick_friend to a two-column layout preserves the screen's core job of choosing a companion.
Updating home_intro text with desktop control tips is a valid copy change inside onboarding.
